description: Poll BLAST RIDs, test synteny via NCBI gene orthologs for CG13494 and its 2R neighbours, and plot corrected dN/dS
code:
import requests, re, time, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---------- 1. Poll the three NCBI BLAST RIDs one more time ----------
print("=== NCBI BLAST RID status ===")
for rid,desc in [("GB0XEGF3014","nr unrestricted"),("GB1NEKWR016","Drosophilidae txid7214"),("GB1NFDGD016","non-Drosophilid")]:
    try:
        r=requests.get("https://blast.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/Blast.cgi",
                       params={"CMD":"Get","FORMAT_OBJECT":"SearchInfo","RID":rid},timeout=45)
        st=re.search(r"Status=(\w+)",r.text)
        he=re.search(r"ThereAreHits=(\w+)",r.text)
        print(f"  {rid:14s} {desc:26s} Status={st.group(1) if st else 'UNKNOWN'}  Hits={he.group(1) if he else 'n/a'}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  {rid}: request failed: {e}")

# ---------- 2. Synteny test: is the Fili(CG34368)-ppk9(CG34369) interval present outside melanogaster group? ----------
print("\n=== Synteny / ortholog presence test via NCBI Gene orthologs ===")
def fetch(url,params,tries=4):
    for t in range(tries):
        r=requests.get(url,params=params,timeout=60)
        if "API rate limit" not in r.text[:300]: return r
        time.sleep(1.5)
    return r
E="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"
# flanking genes of CG13494 on 2R
flank={"CG34368 (Fili)":"43765","CG13488":"37495","CG43405":"19835663","CG13494":"37497","CG34369 (ppk9)":"43766"}
rows=[]
for nm,gid in flank.items():
    try:
        r=fetch(E+"elink.fcgi",{"dbfrom":"gene","db":"gene","id":gid,"linkname":"gene_orthologs","retmode":"json"})
        j=r.json(); ids=[]
        for ls in j["linksets"]:
            for db in ls.get("linksetdbs",[]):
                ids+=db.get("links",[])
        ids=sorted(set(ids)-{gid})
        orgs=[]
        if ids:
            r2=fetch(E+"esummary.fcgi",{"db":"gene","id":",".join(ids[:200]),"retmode":"json"})
            d=r2.json()["result"]
            orgs=sorted({d[i]["organism"]["scientificname"] for i in d.get("uids",[])})
        rows.append(dict(gene=nm,n_orthologs=len(ids),organisms="; ".join(orgs) if orgs else "NONE"))
        print(f"  {nm:16s} orthologs={len(ids):3d}  {('; '.join(orgs))[:150] if orgs else 'NONE in NCBI ortholog set'}")
        time.sleep(1.0)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  {nm}: failed ({e})")
        rows.append(dict(gene=nm,n_orthologs=None,organisms="query failed"))
syn=pd.DataFrame(rows)

# ---------- 3. Corrected dN/dS figure ----------
pairs=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(pair="Dmel vs Dsec",omega=0.133,dN=0.0354,dS=0.2659,p=7.40e-04,aa_id=83.3),
 dict(pair="Dmel vs Dsuz",omega=0.205,dN=0.1405,dS=0.6838,p=7.34e-05,aa_id=59.7),
 dict(pair="Dmel vs Dgun",omega=0.240,dN=0.2496,dS=1.0422,p=2.72e-04,aa_id=54.7),
 dict(pair="Dsuz vs Dgun",omega=0.280,dN=0.2585,dS=0.9226,p=1.67e-04,aa_id=55.9)])
regs=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(region="N-term Thr-rich\n(res 1-34)",omega=0.059,Sd=5.0,Nd=1.0),
 dict(region="TM helix\n(res 35-69)",omega=0.126,Sd=5.0,Nd=2.0),
 dict(region="Cys/Gly/Asp tail\n(res 70-120)",omega=0.163,Sd=7.5,Nd=5.5)])

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.2))
a=axes[0]
a.bar(range(4),pairs.omega,color="#2c7fb8")
a.axhline(1.0,color="#c0392b",ls="--",lw=1.5)
a.text(3.45,1.02,"neutral expectation",color="#c0392b",fontsize=8,ha="right")
for i,r in pairs.iterrows():
    a.text(i,r.omega+0.03,f"{r.omega:.3f}\np = {r.p:.1e}",ha="center",fontsize=7.5)
a.set_xticks(range(4)); a.set_xticklabels(pairs.pair,fontsize=8.5,rotation=12)
a.set_ylim(0,1.2); a.set_ylabel("dN/dS (Nei-Gojobori, Jukes-Cantor corrected)")
a.set_title("CG13494 is under purifying selection in all 4 species pairs",fontsize=10)

b=axes[1]
b.bar(range(3),regs.omega,color=["#8e44ad","#2980b9","#e67e22"])
b.axhline(1.0,color="#c0392b",ls="--",lw=1.5)
for i,r in regs.iterrows():
    b.text(i,r.omega+0.03,f"{r.omega:.3f}\n({r.Nd:.1f} Nd / {r.Sd:.1f} Sd)",ha="center",fontsize=7.5)
b.set_xticks(range(3)); b.set_xticklabels(regs.region,fontsize=8.5)
b.set_ylim(0,1.2); b.set_ylabel("dN/dS")
b.set_title("Constraint spans the whole protein, including the\nlow-complexity tail (Dmel vs Dsec; counts are small)",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

pairs.to_csv("/tmp/x.csv",index=False)
print("\n",pairs.to_string(index=False))
print("\n",regs.to_string(index=False))
